business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of PC and Console Video Games via Digital Stores

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa - International Company regime supervised by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - English common law heritage codified by parliamentary statute; unitary national legal system with no sub-state tax distinctions; customary law limited to land and titles
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) - Samoa in provisional application since 13 December 2020
WTO Agreement - Samoa accession effective 10 May 2012
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) with New Zealand - active under global tax transparency commitments
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) with Australia - active under global tax transparency commitments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 2008 and 2009 (ICA); Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 as amended by the Money Laundering Prevention (Amendment) Acts 2010, 2012, 2018 and 2019 (MLPA); Samoa International Financial Authority Act 2007; United Nations Act 2013 and Sanctions Regulations; International Companies (Fees) Regulations; SIFA AML/CFT Guidelines and related AML/CFT General Regulations; Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual evaluation obligations.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - Beneficial ownership data is obtained, verified and retained by the licensed registered agent and filed with SIFA's central beneficial ownership register; it is not part of the publicly searchable company register. Nominee shareholders and directors are permitted but must be disclosed to the agent and SIFA and cannot frustrate identification of the ultimate beneficial owner.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of UBO passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the UBO's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of UBO (bank statement or utility bill dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank or utility provider, certified by a Notary Public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Banker's reference letter for the UBO and any corporate shareholder
Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry in the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the licensed Samoan registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the principal's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized declaration of source of funds and business profile for the AML file
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: UBO or corporate shareholder, sworn before a Notary Public or certified public accountant

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors and authorized signatories against: (i) the UN Consolidated List and UN Security Council Resolutions as implemented in Samoa under the United Nations Act 2013; (ii) the OFAC SDN list and EU consolidated list as correspondent-bank best practice; (iii) Samoan law-enforcement and immigration watchlists; and (iv) adverse media databases. PEP status (foreign, domestic or international-organization) must be established; enhanced due diligence applies to PEPs, complex ownership chains, high-risk FATF-listed jurisdictions and large digital-revenue flows. SIFA's AML/CFT Guidelines require ongoing transaction monitoring and timely re-verification of UBO data.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SIFA e-Registry platform; name reservations are filed exclusively through licensed Samoan registered agents with the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory register is maintained in English. Proposed names must be expressed in the Roman (Latin) alphabet and must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated' or 'Inc.'. A Chinese-character trading name is permissible only as an auxiliary business name; a notarized certified translation and pinyin transliteration must accompany the reservation so the name can be represented in the English register.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any token implying government affiliation, Crown patronage or licensed banking/insurance/trust activity without prior written consent of the Registrar and the relevant supervisory authority; third-party trademarks require a coexistence or authorization letter from the rights holder
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: a reservation may be renewed for successive 30-day periods by filing a renewal request and fee through the registered agent before expiry, provided the name remains available. Rejection procedure: (1) the registered agent obtains written grounds from the Registrar (typically confusing similarity, prohibited token or policy objection); (2) within 14 days the agent files a revised name containing a distinctive geographic or business qualifier (e.g., 'WS Pacific', 'Pixel Harbor'); (3) if the client insists on the original name, the agent lodges a written administrative appeal with the Registrar within 21 days of refusal, supported by legal arguments and any rights-holder consent letters; (4) if the administrative appeal is dismissed, judicial review may be commenced in the Supreme Court of Samoa under the Judicature Ordinance 1961; (5) concurrently, the name must be cleared against Valve/Steam and PlayStation partner-center naming rules and trademark registries (USPTO, Hong Kong IPD, EUIPO).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is the statutory norm for a Samoa International Company: the only required Samoan physical presence is the registered office at the licensed registered agent's address in Apia. The Steam/PlayStation publishing operation and its staff, servers and storefront contracts will be located in the operational jurisdiction (e.g., Hong Kong or Singapore). No Samoan economic-substance requirement applies to a tax-exempt international company, provided it is not managed and controlled in Samoa and does not undertake treaty-dependent activity in Samoa; however, Valve and Sony may apply independent supplier-vetting standards, and the Samoa entity must evidence ownership of the publishing/IP licensing rights through proper board documentation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - estimated annual probability below 5% of an unannounced physical inspection affecting this file. SIFA conducts risk-based AML inspections of licensed registered agents and may demand access to UBO files and company records on request, but it does not physically inspect the offshore operational premises of a passive international company.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2011; ss. 6-12 (Incorporation, Registered Office, Registered Agent), s. 104 (Annual Licence Fee), and s. 163 (Tax Exemption for International Companies)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration as an International Company, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association; issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital required; an International Company may be incorporated with a single ordinary share of no par value, and no escrow account or capital deposit obligation is imposed
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE SOLE SUBSCRIBER AND FIRST DIRECTOR. By written resolution, the sole subscriber and first director hereby resolves: 1. THAT the Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed with the Registrar of International Companies are adopted. 2. THAT the subscriber subscribes for one (1) ordinary share at par value US$1.00, credited as fully paid. 3. THAT the registered office be established at [Agent Address, Apia, Samoa]. 4. THAT [Name] be appointed Director and [Name] be appointed Secretary/Registered Agent. 5. THAT the Chairman and any Director are authorized to execute all instruments necessary to give effect to these resolutions. Certified a true copy. Dated: [Date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia; submissions effected through a licensed Samoan registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed Name Reservation Form through the licensed registered agent with three rank-ordered proposed corporate names. Pay the WST 30 reservation fee and await official clearance. The cleared name is reserved for 30 calendar days pending completion of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of subscriber passport or national identity document
Brief stated business purpose (ISIC 5820 software/console game publishing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a proposed name is rejected for conflict, offensiveness, or misleading similarity, the registered agent resubmits an amended name list within 5 working days at no additional official fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent for International Companies (authorized by the Registrar to certify constitutional documents)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, incorporating the cleared company name, registered office address in Apia, appointment of the registered agent, objects clause confined to lawful international business, authorized share capital, and director provisions. The subscriber executes the M&A and the agent attests the document for filing.
required_dossiers: Agent-drafted Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent and appointment letter of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The registered agent re-executes and resubmits defective schedules upon Registrar requisition; any corrective amendment chain is documented within 7 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association with the Application for Registration as an International Company and pays the US$100 statutory registration fee. Upon examination, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation with effect from the filing date.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association in duplicate
Application for Registration Form certified by the registered agent
Director's consent to act and indemnity declarations
Certificate of appointment of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition letter, the registered agent submits missing declarations or amended pages within 14 calendar days; the first corrective filing is made without additional official fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inaugural Board Resolutions, Share Subscription and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company; minutes recorded by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The sole subscriber adopts the pro-forma First Board Resolution, subscribes for the initial ordinary share at par, appoints the first director and company secretary/registered agent, and confirms the registered office maintained with the agent in Apia. All entries are lodged in the statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Consent to act forms of director and secretary
Statutory registers of members, directors, and charges
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any defective execution is cured by a unanimous supplementary board resolution adopted within 10 working days and filed with the registered agent's records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Annual Licence Registration and Tax-Exempt Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry for Revenue (Samoa) and International Companies Registry, MCIL
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of incorporation, the registered agent files the company particulars for the annual licence cycle under s. 104 of the International Companies Act 1987 and obtains written confirmation of the statutory tax exemption for International Companies, covering exemption from income tax and VAT on offshore digital publishing revenue.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation
Completed annual licence and particulars form
Registered office and registered agent confirmation
Board resolution confirming the offshore source of Steam/console publishing revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If particulars are queried, the registered agent resubmits corrected returns within 5 working days; any late fee is waived upon proof that the initial filing was made within the statutory period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Business Registry Division, Samoa
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Licence (annual statutory licence under s. 104 of the International Companies Act 1987; no separate sectoral operating permit is required for non-physical, digital game publishing activities)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 - Administrative Registration only; a full Environmental Impact Assessment is not required for office-based digital publishing with no manufacturing or physical production footprint
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial effluent, VOC, or particulate emissions are generated by the activity; compliance is limited to municipal wastewater discharge limits per Samoa Water Authority sewerage standards and to electrical and electronic waste disposal per SPREP guidelines

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) for Class-1 low-occupancy office premises; building occupancy and structural clearance from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure; and workplace occupational health and safety registration under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MfR) of the Independent State of Samoa, successor to the Samoa Tax Office/Department of Inland Revenue, operating jointly with the Samoa Customs Service and the Central Bank of Samoa for exchange control. National e-portal: www.revenue.gov.ws; taxpayer e-services filed electronically via the Samoa Tax Administration System (TAS).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Samoa International Company (IC) is incorporated by the Registrar of International Companies under the International Companies Act; the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the statutory Tax Exemption Certificate. For tax registry purposes, the IC obtains a TIN by filing the MfR TIN application form (Form TIN-01) with: (i) certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation; (ii) Memorandum and Articles of Association; (iii) register of directors and shareholders; and (iv) a statutory declaration confirming non-residence and absence of Samoa-source income. The MfR will not register the IC for income tax or VAGST provided the IC confines its activity to exempt international business; the IC instead pays the annual International Company government license fee to SIFA. If the IC subsequently commences a taxable activity in Samoa, the TIN is activated for income tax and VAGST registration. A non-resident foreign entity without a Samoan presence may obtain a TIN for inbound payment processing, but cannot be voluntarily VAGST-registered absent a taxable activity in Samoa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Samoan domestic law; the IC's exempt status is statutory and evidenced by the Tax Exemption Certificate issued by the Registrar of International Companies. Available elections: (i) application for the exemption certificate at incorporation; (ii) election to convert/redomicile from IC status to a domestic company under the Companies Act 2001, thereby becoming subject to entity-level company income tax (standard corporate rate 27%) and VAGST at 15% on taxable supplies; (iii) election by a foreign corporation to register a Samoan branch, taxed at the entity level on branch profits; and (iv) voluntary VAGST registration below the statutory threshold at the Commissioner's discretion, only where a taxable activity exists. An exempt IC cannot elect pass-through treatment in Samoa.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 200,000 of annual taxable supplies in Samoa; voluntary registration below the threshold is at the Commissioner's discretion; exporters of zero-rated supplies may register to claim input VAT credits.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not operate a real-time invoice clearance or e-invoicing API regime. The mandatory regime comprises: (i) use of MfR-approved Electronic Tax Registers (ETR) and fiscal cash registers/POS software for businesses making taxable supplies to consumers; (ii) mandatory electronic filing of VAGST returns and e-payment through the Tax Administration System (TAS); (iii) no electronic tax stamping of export invoices; and (iv) retention of the full statutory documentation bundle for export zero-rating claims. An exempt IC with no VAGST taxable activity in Samoa is outside the ETR/TAS filing net.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under the VAGST Act 1992 to: (a) goods physically exported from Samoa; (b) services supplied to a non-resident of Samoa who is outside Samoa at the time of supply, provided the services are not performed in connection with land or goods situated in Samoa; and (c) international transport and directly related services. For the Steam/PlayStation digital publishing model, the IC's platform publishing, distribution, and licensing services supplied to Valve Corporation or Sony Interactive Entertainment — both non-resident counterparties — qualify as exported services and, where VAGST registration is held, are assessed at 0% with entitlement to input tax credits. The exemption is lost where the services are rendered to a Samoa resident, are consumed in Samoa, or relate to Samoan real property. The IC must document the transaction as an export of intangible services evidenced by platform payout statements, executed publishing agreements, and inward remittance records.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (e-Customs export entry) where any physical goods are part of the transaction
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export, or a digitally executed service delivery certificate issued by the Valve/PlayStation platform for services
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice from a licensed Samoan bank evidencing receipt of foreign currency within 180 days
Commercial invoice together with Steam Partner or PlayStation Store payout statement
Packing list, purchase order, and insurance certificate (where goods are concerned)
Executed publishing/licensing agreement with Valve Corporation or Sony Interactive Entertainment evidencing the non-resident counterparty and export nature of the supply
Certificate of incorporation or tax residence certificate of the offshore counterparty substantiating non-resident status
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are subject to audit by the Ministry for Revenue and Samoa Customs; the burden of proving export rests on the supplier. Where zero-rating is claimed without the prescribed documentation, or where refunds are obtained fraudulently — including circular fund flows, falsified remittance certificates, or supplies routed to a Samoa-resident related party — the Commissioner may: (i) assess VAGST at 15% on the supply; (ii) impose a shortfall penalty of up to 150% of the tax evaded, plus late-payment interest at the statutory rate; (iii) claw back refunds for up to six years (with the limitation period extended in cases of fraud); (iv) initiate criminal prosecution, with fines of up to WST 5,000 and/or imprisonment of up to five years on conviction; and (v) revoke the IC's Tax Exemption Certificate, resulting in deregistration by SIFA and the loss of tax-exempt zone status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) – Foreign Exchange Division
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) is convertible on current-account transactions; the Samoa International Company (IC) is treated as a non-resident and is exempt from exchange-control approval for foreign-currency operating flows. Capital-account injections into the IC are freely transferable in USD, EUR, or GBP, provided the funds are sourced from non-resident shareholders and the remittance is identified as direct investment equity. Profit remittances are not subject to Samoan withholding tax; the only practical hurdles are bank-level verification of audited financial statements, a board resolution authorizing distribution, and, where conversion to WST is attempted, execution at a CBS-approved bank exchange rate. No dividend-blocking or compulsory local reinvestment rule applies to an IC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident exporters, CBS policy requires export proceeds to be repatriated within 180 days and, unless a foreign-currency retention facility is granted, sold to a licensed Dealer in foreign exchange at no more than 100% conversion into WST. The target IC is outside the resident surrender regime: Steam/PlayStation platform receipts may be collected and retained in USD/EUR with 0% mandatory conversion, and no Samoan foreign-exchange surrender certificate is triggered for non-resident banking flows.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account + Operational Clearing Account (USD/EUR)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium; offshore electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as EU/UK payment licence holders are not licensed or passported by CBS and cannot provide a Samoan settlement address. They are viable only as a collection overlay for low-value Steam/PlayStation receipts if the EMI maintains a licensed money-service business in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction and sweeps funds to the Samoan licensed bank within 48 hours. Legal constraints: no EMI may hold or claim to hold a Samoa banking licence, all account-opening questionnaires must affirm that the ultimate settlement cushion is held at a CBS-regulated bank, and the EMI’s licence, audited financials, and business-continuity/disaster-recovery plan must be presented as part of the mother-bank KYC file.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person presence is the working rule. Samoan licensed banks normally require at least one director or the registered agent’s compliance officer to attend a KYC interview at the Apia branch before account activation. Remote video onboarding is permitted only on a discretionary basis for existing customers or where the beneficial owner is an institutional-regulated parent; a notarized board resolution, apostilled corporate register extract, certified passports, and the original banker’s questionnaire must nevertheless be couriered. The registered agent for the IC must remain a Samoa-licensed registered agent and may attend the interview as the authorized signing representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with no physical staff and non-resident directors appearing as tax-haven red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation; International Companies Act 1987 register extract; registered agent certificate; accurate up-to-date UBO register; passport copies with apostille; board resolution establishing treasury mandate; a signed declaration that no business is carried on with Samoan residents; audited balance sheet; and an economic-substance declaration covering digital publishing operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume consumer payments from Steam and PlayStation with refund/chargeback traffic and no conventional trade invoice.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Valve/Steam and Sony PlayStation publishing/payout agreements; quarterly settlement statements; user-country revenue reports; platform refund and chargeback ledger; reconciliation of all inbound wires to the operating account; and an e-commerce VAT/GST filing history or exemption certificate where publication rights are licensed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-lateral disbursements to affiliate licensees and sub-publishers in several countries, perceived as layering or royalty splitting.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master licensing and intercompany royalty agreements; transfer-pricing documentation and CbC report if group threshold applies; board-approved cash-flow forecast; list of ultimate payees; source-of-wealth statements for parent shareholders; and CBS or bank confirmation that each foreign-currency disbursement is an approved IC flow not requiring individual exchange-control consent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt IC status causing suspicion of evasion despite valid digital trade.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Samoa tax-exemption letter from Ministry for Revenue; International Companies Act registration; audited financial statements; no-resident-conduct statutory declaration; underlying game/software copyright registrations; and, where relevant, an Advance Pricing Agreement or cross-border tax advice demonstrating arm’s-length royalty allocation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103 only; field 70 must carry the marker 'INV-CAP / WS_IC / ISIC5820' plus the entity name. The remitter parent treasury should cite CBS BOP purpose category 'Direct Investment – Equity Capital in a Samoa International Company' and must not route through a personal account. The receiving Samoan bank will require: signed board resolutions; updated share register; registered agent certificate; source-of-funds statement; and audited parent financial statements. The foreign currency is credited directly to the FCY account of the IC; conversion into WST is optional and requires a CBS notification on the applicable dealer form if the amount crosses the current reporting threshold.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Digital-publishing settlements (royalties, platform fees, affiliate splits) clear by SWIFT MT103 against a commercial agreement number in field 70 and the supporting platform payout statement. Where physical merchandising or localized console discs are procured, an irrevocable commercial Letter of Credit (UCP 600) opened through ANZ/BSP is the acceptable clearing rail, with a freight-forwarder bill of lading and inspection certificate attached at the LC’s settlement bank. All outbound wires from the Samoan IC account should be pre-notified to the relationship manager, with a standing instruction that WST-denominated disbursements are executed only when an FX forward covers the exposure.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable USD/WST forward contracts with tenors up to 12 months executed through a CBS-licensed bank
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on WST against USD/EUR/GBP used to hedge non-Samoan platform settlement flows when no local WST delivery is needed
Cross-currency interest-rate/principal swaps between USD/EUR and WST, documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement and subject to CBS counterparty notification
Vanilla currency options and zero-cost collars to cap adverse USD/WST rate moves on the retained tala portion of the treasury

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal Filing and Government Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) - International Companies Registry, through licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation plus 30-day grace period, with final cut-off on 31 December of each calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of USD 50 plus 10% of the renewal fee; strike-off proceedings commence after 12 months of non-payment, and assets may vest in the Custodian of Property.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following each anniversary of incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil penalty of USD 500 per late or inaccurate declaration; repeated default referred to the Anti-Money Laundering Supervisory Authority for enforcement, potentially leading to registration cancellation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Company Secretary Annual Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each anniversary date, within a mandatory 60-day filing window.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: USD 25 monthly late-filing penalty; six months of continuous default triggers administrative deregistration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory asset/revenue threshold applies. International Companies are exempt from mandatory audit unless required by the company's articles of association, an extraordinary shareholder resolution (at least 5% of voting rights), or a direction from the Financial Services Authority. A statutory audit is also required if the company undertakes an activity requiring a licence under bank, insurance, or securities laws.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by Samoa; where audit is not required, books and records must nevertheless be sufficient to allow IFRS-compliant financial statements to be prepared.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each year, the registered agent must file a beneficial owner confirmation with SIFA identifying every individual or entity owning or controlling 25% or more of shares or voting rights. Share transfers require an updated register and a UBO notification to SIFA within 14 days; the annual confirmation reconciles all prior-year transfers before the anniversary deadline.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 - 1,200 per annum for a standard international company, excluding government fees
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 - 7,500 per engagement, applicable only if audit obligation is triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for a qualifying Samoa International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1987. The IC is exempt from income tax on offshore business profits, capital gains, and non-resident dividends, interest, and royalties, provided it does not carry on business in Samoa, holds no Samoan-source income, is not beneficially owned by Samoan residents, and files its statutory annual return. All other resident companies pay the standard 27% headline rate with no general investment allowance for digital publishing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR) submitted by the licensed Samoa registered agent through the Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA) e-Filing portal to the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 60 days after each anniversary of incorporation (not a fiscal-year-end filing).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part A - Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered legal name of the International Company and its unique IC registration number (e.g., IC-123456).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners must ensure the name exactly matches the certificate of incorporation; no Samoan trading name may be declared.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part B - Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoa physical registered office address and the licensed registered agent's name and license number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be a licensed Samoan international company service provider; a P.O. box alone is not an acceptable registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and shareholding percentages of all directors and shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors must be individually identified; any nominee or trust arrangement must be disclosed to the registered agent for the beneficial ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital, number of shares, and class of shares (ordinary, preference, founder).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Samoa law imposes no minimum capital; par-value or no-par-value shares are permitted for non-resident owners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part E - Statutory Declaration of Compliance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration by the directors that the company has complied with the International Companies Act 1987, including maintenance of the share register, minute book, and beneficial ownership register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may execute the declaration outside Samoa; the signed original must be lodged with the registered agent in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the International Company has not derived income from Samoan sources and has not carried on business within Samoa during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This declaration is the keystone of the income tax exemption; any local trading activity, physical presence, or employment activity in Samoa would nullify the exemption and trigger full 27% taxation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fee of WST 100 per month or part thereof; continued default beyond 6 months exposes the IC to deregistration or strike-off by the Registrar; restoration after strike-off costs WST 500 plus arrears. Misdeclaration attracts fines up to WST 5,000 and imprisonment of directors for up to 2 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form IR-6 Company Income Tax Return (conditional) filed through the Samoa Tax Online (STO) portal of the Ministry of Revenue. Applicable only if the IC loses its International Company exemption by deriving Samoan-source income, maintaining a permanent establishment in Samoa, or becoming beneficially owned by a Samoan resident.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the end of the fiscal year (e.g., by 30 June for a 31 December year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Goods and Revenue Tax / Taxpayer Identification Number and registration details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A formerly exempt IC must apply for a TIN within 30 days of the event that caused loss of exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income from Steam, PlayStation Store, and other digital publishing revenue streams.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs are taxable only on Samoa-source income; foreign digital store revenue is not taxable if the exemption is lost solely due to Samoan management and control.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions for development costs, licensing fees, platform commissions, bandwidth, and administrative expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must satisfy the arm's-length standard; payments of royalties or interest to non-residents are deductible only if Samoan non-resident WHT has been withheld and remitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Assessable income less allowable deductions, offset by any loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may be carried forward for no more than 5 years and are forfeited on a change of 50% or more in beneficial ownership.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Self-assessed corporate income tax at 27%, less amounts paid under provisional tax instalments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment must be made via Samoa Tax Online by the statutory deadline; tax clearance certificates may be required for foreign profit repatriation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of the greater of 20% of the unpaid tax or WST 1,000; late payment interest accrues at 1.5% per month; failure to self-assess is an offence attracting fines up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for distributions by a qualifying Samoa International Company; the general statutory non-resident dividend withholding rate is 15% for dividends paid by a resident trading company subject to the Income Tax Act 2015.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa maintains a very limited comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) network, principally the Samoa-New Zealand and Samoa-Australia arrangements, plus an extensive Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) network. A non-resident claimant seeking treaty relief must: (1) obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the home tax authority; (2) complete Ministry of Revenue Form WHT-TR1; (3) lodge the TRC and Form WHT-TR1 with the Samoa Commissioner of Revenue before or at the time of the payment; and (4) receive a written reduced-rate approval. The paying IC must retain the approval to justify applying a treaty rate instead of the 15% statutory non-resident rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for IP licensed into Samoa: 15% statutory non-resident WHT, reduced to 10% under certain DTA provisions. Interest to non-resident lenders: 15% statutory WHT, reduced to 10% under DTA provisions where applicable. An exempt International Company paying royalties or interest out of offshore funds is generally outside the Samoan non-resident WHT net because the IC is not a resident company for Income Tax Act purposes.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Cross-border related-party transactions, including platform payouts, intercompany licensing, and management fees, reaching or exceeding WST 600,000 per annum (approximately USD 220,000) require a contemporaneous transfer pricing study applying the arm's-length principle; the Commissioner may also require a Samoa transfer pricing policy, master file, or local file within 30 days' notice where aggregate related-party turnover exceeds WST 1,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa has adopted OECD-aligned economic substance regulations with effect for International Companies undertaking 'relevant activities' (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, IP holding, distribution, and service centres). Pure digital game publishing via Steam or PlayStation is not in the ESR relevant-activity list; nevertheless, the International Company must demonstrate minimum substance: a registered office in Samoa, a licensed resident registered agent, a maintained beneficial ownership register, and at least one annual board meeting (wherever held) with minutes filed at the registered office. Failure to demonstrate substance exposes the IC to striking-off and the loss of the tax exemption.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely declaring in Part F of the IC Annual Return that no Samoan-source income was derived while the IC actually operated a Samoan fixed base, employed staff in Samoa, or contracted with Samoan consumers; knowingly understating assessable income on Form IR-6 after loss of exempt status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalty of 100% of the tax evaded plus late payment interest at 1.5% per month; criminal conviction carries a fine up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years per offence; deregistration of the International Company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed a false declaration or knowingly caused the company to evade tax are personally and severally liable for the unpaid tax and penalties; courts may impose civil restitution, a travel ban with passport surrender, and custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Samoa IC as a pure nominee shell with no books, no bank account in the name of the IC, no board meetings, no separate economic activity, and no registered agent oversight while channelling Steam and PlayStation payouts through personal accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and deregistration under the International Companies Act 1987; default fines of WST 500 to WST 5,000 plus WST 100 per day of continued default; re-registration refused until all arrears and penalties are paid.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced on grounds of sham and fraudulent trading; directors, including shadow directors and nominee shareholders, are jointly liable for all company debts, and an asset confiscation order may attach to their personal property.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to identify and verify beneficial owners, failure to file suspicious transaction reports with the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), or structuring Steam/console royalty and payout flows to conceal the true economic beneficiary or source of funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018, a body corporate may be fined up to WST 500,000; an individual may be imprisoned up to 14 years; the IC and associated bank accounts are subject to freezing orders and confiscation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners face personal criminal liability, disqualification from acting as company officers, travel bans, and confiscation of proceeds; professional directors of nominee companies face revocation of their Samoa trust and company service provider licences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Carrying on business in Samoa, deriving Samoan-source income, becoming resident in Samoa through management and control, or being beneficially owned directly or indirectly by a Samoan resident or Samoan permanent resident.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retroactive revocation of the International Company tax exemption; the company is assessed to 27% corporate income tax on all income for the full year of disqualification, plus a 20% late filing penalty and 1.5% monthly interest; the IC may be struck off and excluded from the International Companies register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the company's back taxes where the disqualification resulted from their own acts or omissions; Samoan courts may issue a personal tax certificate clearance requirement before any director or shareholder may leave Samoa, and may impose a civil restitution order against personal assets.
